Hey guys, grab a pair of dumbbells and follow along with this arms and shoulders workout. Follow the on-screen timers and work out to music. If you want the full form explanation, watch Home Arm Workout: Shoulders, Biceps & Triceps With Just Dumbbells (Do It With Me): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZxsFnsv7mLo

First, we're doing 30 seconds of bicep curls, then 30 seconds of side lateral raises, then 30 seconds of overhead triceps extensions. Once you've finished all three exercises, rest for 30 seconds before you go again. For beginners replay 2 more rounds; for advanced guys replay 4 more rounds, just like it says on the closing screen, so you're doing 3 or 5 rounds total.
